title: DKTV detector sidecar
description: One entry per canonical rule id (skills/*.skill.md registry). Declares HOW each rule is proven. Enforced by scripts/validate-detectors.mjs — that script is the source of truth (it compiles regexes and checks per-tool spec shape); this file documents the contract. Post-audit (2026-10-06): `query` prose and `confidence` were removed — prose queries validated nothing and confidence was the same defect class as invented severities. `spec` is structured per tool and must parse. `ausencia` marks checks that only prove the ABSENCE of a guard (weaker proof, labelled differently in the report). The census stays PROVISIONAL until positive/negative fixtures exist per rule (PLAN.md Fase 1).

type.description: detector = a deterministic tool proves the PRESENCE of the violation; ausencia = a deterministic check proves only the ABSENCE of a guard/config (weaker proof, reported separately); juicio = a model decides applicability AND violation with a closed question; fuera = not detectable and not judgeable — declared, never deleted.

tool.description: Required when type is detector or ausencia; must be absent otherwise.

spec.description: Structured, tool-specific declaration. Shape is enforced per tool by scripts/validate-detectors.mjs: gitleaks {regex, path_regex?, keywords?}; semgrep {pattern, languages[], path_glob?}; osv-scanner {severity_min? | kev_only? | unmaintained_months? | transitive?}; npm-audit {severity_min}; node-matcher {matcher, params} with matcher in the validator's registry; yaml-check {file_glob, check: presence|absence, pattern}; git-log {check, threshold?}; license-scan {allowlist[]}; github-api {check, threshold_days?}.
